rationale: Bloom Energy (BE) is experiencing a massive hyper-growth cycle (130% YoY) driven by AI data center power demands, propelling its valuation to $82.6B. aiThesis.rationale: Bloom Energy is uniquely positioned to solve the acute power bottleneck facing AI hyperscalers. At $82B market cap, it has graduated into a mega-cap infrastructure play. However, hardware manufacturing at scale carries execution risks. While margins recently turned positive (0.25%), getting to software-like margins to justify a 40x P/S multiple is challenging. The base case ($180 PV) assumes exceptional execution, but the current $290 price requires the 'Bull' scenario (80% 5Y CAGR, 20% net margin) to play out.
